name: TOP Mitty
author: Malachite Laurent
description: Party mitigation for TOP from Malachite Laurent's plan. Pick a tank position, a healer job, or a DPS position.

mechanics.note: Mitigation for Optimized Meteor and Cosmo Memory.

phases.note: After Playstation: Feint / Addle are free to use to help with tank autos (it does not work on flares or cosmo memory)

15s party mit should be pressed after the second hit of the tank buster
10s party mit should be pressed at the start of the raidwide cast
For WAR/PLD, GNB/DRK, GNB/PLD, PLD/DRK: Healers must put personal mit on tanks or they die to busters.

T1.name: Tank LB
T1.note: First tank LB priority: WAR > DRK > PLD >>>>>>> GNB

mechanics.note: Don't press 10s mit too early on the wave cannon or it will fall off for the wild charge. Press it after the 1st set of proteans go off.
